Usage: impeccable design-lookup <term>... [--target <path>]

Print the design tokens, components and DESIGN.md sections whose name or value
contains a term (case-insensitive), each with the file it lives in: DESIGN.md's
frontmatter, .impeccable/design.json, the token files DESIGN.md names, and its
sections. Use it for a detail the DESIGN.md map in `context` leaves out instead
of reading a whole file.

--target <path>  Select a workspace in a monorepo.
